plan.new.title: New job
plan.new.lead: A job is what part of each month's money is for. It can save towards a goal, and it can live in a bucket or another account.
plan.new.kind.label: What kind of job
plan.new.field.name: Name
plan.new.field.essentialHelp: The household needs it to keep running. The app never takes an essential job's money for another job.
plan.new.field.keepsMoneyHelp: What you don't spend stays in a bucket for later months.
plan.new.field.paidFromHelp: The account its bills leave from.
plan.new.field.paidFromPayHelp: The shared account the money leaves from.
plan.new.account.name: Account name
plan.new.account.balanceHelp: You type this balance in, and the app shows it as entered by you.
plan.new.account.import: Also import this account's statements, so its balance stays up to date
plan.new.account.numberHelp: As the bank prints it on a statement. The app finds the account by it.
plan.new.payInto.note: The app counts money you pay into a child's account as saving, not spending.
plan.new.reach: That is {monthly} a month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}, {from} to {to}.
plan.new.reachOne: That is {monthly} in {month}, all at once.
plan.new.reachWaiting: Enter a target and a date, and the app works out what each month takes.
plan.new.reachTarget: Set a target and a date instead
plan.new.sits.preferred: {neighbours, plural, =0 {As a bucket in {account}} other {As a bucket in {account}, next to {names}}}
plan.new.sits.own: In an account of its own
plan.new.sits.ownHelp: The app adds a shared account called {name} for this job.
plan.new.from.legend: Where does the money come from?
plan.new.from.waiting: Once you enter an amount, the app shows where it can come from before anything changes.
plan.new.from.covered: Every {currency, select, NOK {krone} other {unit of money}} already has a job. The {unassigned} with no job covers all of it, so no other job gives anything up.
plan.new.from.partly: Every {currency, select, NOK {krone} other {unit of money}} already has a job. The {unassigned} without one covers part of it. You need to move the other {rest} from another job.
plan.new.from.none: Every {currency, select, NOK {krone} other {unit of money}} already has a job. You need to move {rest} from another job.
plan.new.from.short: This job needs {amount}. The money with no job and every job the app could take from add up to {available}, which is {short} short. The app never takes money from an essential job, so lower the amount or free up money first.
plan.new.from.notOpen: {month} isn't open yet, so the app takes nothing from another job now. The job starts when {month} opens.
plan.new.from.closed: {month} is closed, so the app takes nothing from another job now. The job starts in {next}.
plan.new.from.reason: Add job waits until the money covers it: {short} is still missing.
plan.new.effects.title: What this would change
plan.new.effects.note: Nothing changes until you press Add job.
plan.new.effects.laterBuffer: The buffer reaches {buffer, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} about {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} later, in {ready}.
plan.new.effects.earlierBuffer: The buffer reaches {buffer, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} about {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} sooner, in {ready}.
plan.new.effects.later: {name} reaches its target about {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} later, in {ready}.
plan.new.effects.earlier: {name} reaches its target about {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} sooner, in {ready}.
plan.new.effects.losesDate: {name} would get no money, so it has no date to reach its target.
plan.new.effects.refused: The app can't add this job as it stands. {reason}
plan.new.summary: {count, plural, one {One answer is} other {# answers are}} missing or wrong. Each is marked above.
plan.new.problem.name: Give the job a name.
plan.new.problem.groupMissing: Choose a group, or add a new one.
plan.new.problem.groupName: Give the new group a name.
plan.new.problem.readyByMissing: Choose the month it should be ready by.
plan.new.problem.readyByTooEarly: Choose {from} or a later month. {from} is the first month this job gets money.
plan.new.problem.sits: Choose where the money should sit.
plan.new.problem.paidFrom: Choose the account it is paid from.
plan.new.problem.payInto: Choose the account it pays into, or add one.
plan.new.problem.balance: Enter the balance as an amount, 0 or more.
plan.new.problem.balanceDate: Enter the day the balance is for.
plan.new.problem.number: Enter the account number as the bank prints it.
plan.new.problem.numberTaken: Another account already has this number.
plan.new.done.leadTarget: You added {name}: {monthly} a month from {from}, {target} by {by}.
plan.new.done.bucket: The app keeps it as a bucket in {account}.
plan.new.done.own: The app keeps it in a new account called {account}.
plan.new.done.paidFrom: The app takes its bills from {account}.
plan.new.done.paysInto: The app counts it as saving and pays it into {account}.
plan.new.done.paysIntoNew: The app counts it as saving and pays it into {account}, which it added.
plan.new.done.tookEqually: The app took the rest equally from {jobs}.
plan.new.done.took: The app took the rest from {jobs}.
plan.new.done.nextMonth: {month} is closed, so it starts in {next}.
plan.new.undone: You undid adding {name}. What you typed is still here.
